label: Full ejection
type: the Couchbase-bucket policy under which keys and metadata are ejected along with values, trading memory for extra disk reads on access.
note: The only enum member besides the head to clear the recurrence bar on its own. Member of the ejection-policy closed set, promoted as a family: memory:ejection-policy clears the recurrence bar and memory:full-ejection does too, while the remaining members sit at 1. An enum promoted with some values missing is worse than useless - a consumer cannot tell an absent value from an invalid one - so the set is completed deliberately and the exception is recorded here rather than left implicit.
